newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi cabinet to meet in Mecca on Thursday instead of Monday, minister says.
- Accused Filipino welfare official leaves for Manila to answer charges of assault leveled against him by a maid.
- Saudi committee for helping indebted prisoners and the poor collected 20 million riyals to pay the debts of 94 prisoners in the kingdom.
- Police seize 970 grams of heroin at King Abdul-Aziz International Airport in Jeddah.
- Saudi Industrial Fund extends new loans worth 379 million riyals.
- New roads to be built in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province this year at a cost of 141 million riyals, minister says.
